texts.value: By acting through a filamin-A/F-actin axis, it controls the start of neocortical cell migration from the ventricular zone. May be able to induce the degradation of filamin-A

Moderately expressed in adult heart and brain. Weakly expressed in lung, skeletal muscle, ovary, testis, kidney, and fetal brain, and hardly detectable in liver, pancreas, spleen, and fetal liver. Within brain, moderate expression is found in amygdala and caudate nucleus (PubMed:10574462). Expressed in skin fibroblasts

disease.description: An autosomal recessive neuromuscular disorder characterized by multiple congenital joint contractures, hypotonia, muscle weakness, and facial dysmorphism. Patients may also exhibit motor delay, speech delay, impaired intellectual development, and abnormal brain imaging.
